subject: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots across timezones
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Chen <lucy.chen@novusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up + proposed rotating demo slots

Hi Lucy / Tom —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the deep dive into Novus Retail's latency and throughput targets for your catalog search assistant. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: your primary goals are sub-200ms 95th token latency for short-form prompts, embedding-based reranking for search relevance, and multi-region failover between US/EU.
- Next step: 60-75 minute technical demo + ops discussion (runtime, SLOs, rollout). We'll bring an infra engineer and our Solutions Engineer.

Because your team spans EU and APAC overlap, and our SE (Priyom) is primarily APAC-friendly while Marissa and I are US/EU, we typically propose a rotating set of demo slots so the recurring demos alternate to accommodate off-hours for each group. Below are three rotating-week options — pick the one that works best and we'll send a calendar invite (I included tentative ICS in attachments):

Option A (rotate weekly)
- Week 1: US-friendly — Tue 10:00 PT / Tue 13:00 ET / Wed 18:00 CEST
- Week 2: EU-friendly — Tue 16:00 CEST / Tue 10:00 ET / Wed 00:00 JST
- Week 3: APAC-friendly — Wed 09:00 JST / Tue 17:00 CEST / Tue 08:00 PT

Option B (fixed middle ground)
- Wed 08:00 PT / Wed 11:00 ET / Wed 17:00 CEST / Thu 01:00 JST (best for regular weekly cadence, lower fatigue)

Option C (two-week rotate)
- Week A: Mon 11:00 PT / Mon 14:00 ET / Mon 20:00 CEST
- Week B: Thu 09:00 JST / Thu 02:00 PT / Thu 05:00 ET

If helpful, we can do an initial one-off at whatever time is easiest this week and then start rotating from the next session.

Attached: Novus_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf (agenda + prompts we plan to run), timezone-rotating-slots.ics (tentative calendar with all options).

Would love to lock a time — are you available for Option A (next Tue 10:00 PT) or prefer Option B?

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform

From: Lucy Chen <lucy.chen@novusretail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Garrett <t.garrett@novusretail.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 00:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up + proposed rotating demo slots

Hi Aditya —

Thanks, this is really helpful — appreciated the clear recap. Quick thoughts from our side:

- Goal confirmation: yes to the latency and reranking goals. We also want to see token-level cost implications for our 2.5B prompt distribution.
- For the demo attendees: I will bring our ML infra lead (Tom) and our Head of Product (Sofia) — copying Tom here.

About slots: Option A is ideal for timing on our side if we can do Week 1 as US-friendly next week, but the Wed 18:00 CEST in Week 1 would be tough for Sofia. Option B's fixed middle ground looks promising — less context switching.

Can we do a one-off this coming Wednesday 17:00 CEST (which maps to Wed 08:00 PT) to get started and then switch to Option B's regular cadence? If that works for your SE schedule (Priyom), we can confirm now.

Also, could you include a short pre-demo checklist (input data format, credentials we'll need, any sample prompts you want us to run)?

Best,
Lucy
Senior Product Manager, Novus Retail
lucy.chen@novusretail.com

Lucy —

Yep — Wed 17:00 CEST works for us this week. Priyom (cc'd) can do Wed 01:00 JST and that maps to your 17:00 CEST. Marissa will lead the product walkthrough; Priyom will cover deployment/ops and SLOs.

Pre-demo checklist (high level):
- Data: sample search queries + a CSV of top 10k SKUs (anonymized is fine).
- Access: a temporary S3 bucket or similar for any test datasets (we don't need production access).
- Expected outputs: examples of search results + desired reranking metric (precision@K or recall) you want us to optimize for.
- Tech: please whitelist outgoing connections from our IP range (we'll share IPs in a follow-up), and if you require any network peering we can discuss in the ops segment.

I'll send an invite for Wed Jul 22, 17:00 CEST / Wed Jul 22, 08:00 PT / Thu Jul 23, 01:00 JST and mark it as "one-off initial session" with the rotating cadence to start after. Attaching the agenda again.

If anything changes, tell me and we can pivot.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 02:05:00 +05:30
Subject: Internal: prep notes for Novus demo (Jul 22)

Quick internal notes before I join the call: 

- Agenda: 1) 15m quick recap + objectives 2) 20m live demo (embedding + rerank) 3) 15m ops deep dive (batching/caching, autoscale) 4) 15m Q&A + next steps
- Priyom: please prepare the quantization and KV cache notes (especially how batching influences 95th percentile latency in EU region).
- Me: I'll bring the prompt set and two candidate model profiles (1: low latency quantized 8-bit, 2: slightly higher quality fp16 with caching).
- Ask aditya to confirm calendar invite contains all rotating options and clear indicator this week is a one-off.

Also — given timezone fatigue, let's make the regular cadence Option B (fixed middle ground) unless Novus pushes back after the first session. That reduces stress on Priyom and keeps Sofia in normal hours.

-Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
